clips.title: The story
paras: At the Shrine of the Dormant Flame, Telf Joolam guides Horde initiates through the trials of fire. The Darkspear shaman teaches them to commune with and command the volatile element.

Telf Joolam tends the Shrine of the Dormant Flame among the crags overlooking the borderlands. Fire spirits demand sharp discipline and unwavering focus, unlike the calm certainty of earth or the patient depth of water. Telf prepares young shamans for trials that test their worth before the wild embers consume them.

Under Telf's direction, initiates brew and drink a ritual Fire Sapta, opening their mortal eyes to the unseen elemental planes. He sends them up the rocky summits to face burning spirits. Those who earn the flame must respect its ravenous hunger and resist reckless pride.
